name: bend2-tooling
description: A complete, proof-aware developer experience for Bend 2.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/toolchain && npm run build --workspace packages/language-server && npm run build --workspace apps/vscode
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/toolchain && npm run test --workspace packages/language-server && npm run test --workspace apps/vscode
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run bundle && node scripts/integration.mjs
scripts.test:web: npm run build && npm run bundle && node scripts/web-integration.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run bundle && npm run verify-reproducible && npm run verify-vsix
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run bundle && npm run verify-bundle
